jobs.description:
You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Responsibilities:

At this position, your tasks will be highly varied. One day you might be performing (preventive) maintenance on industrial compressors, while the next you could be conducting complex repairs on a generator. In short, you'll have plenty of technical challenges and day-to-day variety.

• Conduct maintenance and repairs on rental equipment such as diesel generators and compressors to ensure optimal performance and safety

• Perform scheduled inspections and preventive maintenance routines to guarantee fleet reliability

• Troubleshoot technical issues, including mechanical and electrical problems, on site or in the workshop

• Prepare equipment efficiently after use to ensure readiness for the next customer

• Document maintenance activities and communicate technical findings clearly to team members and clients

• At least 2/3 years as a workshop technician/ engineer
• Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or a related technical field
• Strong knowledge of diesel engines, compressors, and electrical systems, including reading electrical diagrams 
• Fluency in English, with excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation
• Proven problem solving skills, results oriented mindset, and the ability to work independently or in a team
• Flexibility regarding working hours and a proactive attitude toward continuous learning and development

Take over an established portfolio, not a blank page: live accounts, long-term contracts and a clear path to running a full programme.

IT Project Manager | Client Accounts | Brussels

Our client is a Belgian company specialised in integrating software solutions at its clients’ sites — heavily customised platforms it deploys, tailors and maintains in their environment, often for years.

What makes it stand out? Its accounts sit on long-term framework contracts. You inherit live projects, established relationships and a team that already knows the platforms, rather than starting from scratch.

Part of the technical delivery runs through an external partner, which makes managing the triangle between client, internal teams and partner a core part of the job rather than a side task.

As it grows, the company is looking for a senior IT Project Manager to take over an existing portfolio, with a path towards running a full programme already mapped out internally.

 

The job

• You take ownership of several client accounts: implementations, contractual commitments, budgets, service quality and the relationship with decision-makers.
• You are the point of contact between the client, the internal teams and the technical partner, and you keep a firm grip on the functional content of the work.
 
Role
• Lead implementation and upgrade projects at the client’s site, from scoping through to go-live.
• Manage budgets, deadlines and contractual commitments, arbitrating between what was promised to the client and what the partner can deliver.
• Steer the external partner day to day: capacity, quality of deliverables, deadlines and escalations.
• Work with the business analyst on scoping client needs: challenge requests, measure them against the platform and decide which customisations to retain.
• Follow up on run and ticketing, anticipate contractual and budgetary risks, and bring the difficult trade-offs to the client.
Profile
• Senior experience on the vendor side — integrator, software vendor or consultancy — deploying software solutions at external clients. A purely in-house background on corporate IT projects is not a fit for this role.
• Comfortable with the functional side: you understand the solutions you deploy and can challenge an analysis rather than only coordinate. You also know your way around contractual mechanics, fixed-price and time-and-materials alike.
• Fluent English is essential; diplomacy, administrative rigour and the ability to hold your ground with a demanding client.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit? 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

We are looking for a flexible, part-time nurse to support clinical research activities in a Phase I study environment. 
You will perform basic clinical tasks and ensure participant safety while working according to study protocols. 
The role is ideal for someone who wishes to combine this position with another part-time job.

Main Responsibilities :
 

 
•  
Collecting data and biological samples (mainly blood draws) 

 
• Performing ECG measurements 
 

 
• Measuring and monitoring vital signs 
 
•  
Ensuring the safety and well-being of study participants 

 
• Accurate documentation and reporting of clinical data 
 
• Working according to established procedures and study guidelines 

Nursing diploma A2 level (or equivalent) 
Quickly deployable 
Basic tasks with short training period 
Flexible availability, depending on the ongoing research activities 
Suitable for candidates combining multiple part-time roles 
Strong sense of responsibility, accuracy, and participant care Languages: French + basic English Able to work independently as well as within a multidisciplinary clinical team

The Software & Services (SAS) Competence Centre is looking for a Application & Platform Security Architect to help shape the secure and sustainable digitalization of VITO. As our software landscape continues to grow, cybersecurity expectations in research and innovation projects increase, and regulations such as NIS2 become more important, we are looking for an expert who can develop an organization-wide architectural vision and translate it into practical guidelines, standards, and improvement initiatives. You will help research software evolve from prototypes into reliable operational solutions and support teams in integrating security, compliance, and best practices from the very start of their developments.

 

You will join a multidisciplinary team of around 30 software engineers, DevOps specialists, analysts, and project managers with a strong affinity for scientific research. Together, we bridge the gap between research and impact by developing digital solutions that make scientific insights accessible to industry, policymakers, and society.

 

Our expertise spans three main domains: application development, supporting researchers in building high-quality software, and providing scalable research platforms such as Kubernetes, cloud, and HPC environments. We combine software engineering, AI-assisted development, DevOps, cybersecurity, and data infrastructure to accelerate the transition from research to reliable operational solutions.

 

Within SAS, you will have the opportunity to work on challenges with real societal impact, collaborate with leading researchers, and contribute to an organization-wide culture of software engineering and innovation.

 

What will you do?

You will work closely with researchers, software engineers, DevOps specialists, and project teams to embed security by design into our digital solutions.

 

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Assessing the current security posture of VITO's internally developed applications and defining a phased roadmap towards NIS2 compliance.

• 
Defining, implementing, and maintaining security standards, architectural guidelines, and software development best practices across the organization.

• 
Developing policy frameworks, guidelines, and reusable building blocks to integrate cybersecurity into research proposals and innovation projects from the outset.

• 
Reviewing application architectures and development processes across a diverse software landscape, and identifying improvement opportunities related to security, quality, maintainability, and operational maturity.

• 
Supporting and coaching development teams in adopting secure coding principles, modern CI/CD practices, and scalable architectural patterns.

• 
Promoting a consistent and future-oriented software engineering approach in which security, compliance, and quality are built in by default.

• 
Acting as a bridge between IT, software development, and research, ensuring that innovative solutions can safely evolve from prototypes into operational services.

 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to make an organization-wide impact on how digital solutions are designed, developed, and operated within a leading research organization.

• 
A Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

• 
At least 5 years of experience in software architecture, security architecture, application security, or a related field.

• 
Strong understanding of secure software development practices, application security principles, and modern software architectures.

• 
Experience with cloud-native technologies, container platforms (e.g. Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.

• 
Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, standards, and regulations such as NIS2, ISO 27001, OWASP, or similar.

• 
Experience conducting architecture reviews, risk assessments, and translating security requirements into practical guidance for development teams.

• 
The ability to balance security, usability, innovation, and operational realities in a research-driven environment.

• 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling you to collaborate effectively with researchers, developers, IT teams, and management.

• 
A proactive mindset with the ability to drive change and build consensus across diverse teams.

• 
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is considered an asset.

 

Nice to have

• 
Experience in research, innovation, or R&D-driven environments.

• 
Knowledge of AI/ML platforms, data-intensive applications, or scientific software development.

• 
Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, Azure Security Engineer, or similar.

• 
Experience establishing security governance, secure development frameworks, or organization-wide security improvement programs.

 

Offer

• 
We operate in an activity‑based way, meaning your work activities guide where you work. Our headquarter is located in Mol, and we anticipate an average onsite presence of about 50%. We also support flexibility: parttime remote work or working from one of our satellite offices in Antwerp‑Berchem, Genk, Ghent, Leuven, Kortrijk or Ostend is possible.

• 
A competitive salary with a range of benefits, including allowances, insurance, and a modular package of holidays.

• 
Innovation is our asset, so it goes without saying that we give our employees the opportunity to take additional training courses and stay up-to-date in their field. You will always have the opportunity to broaden your knowledge and discover new technologies.

• 
You will have the opportunity to be part of an organization with an international reputation, known for its cutting-edge technological research and scientific consultancy.

• 
With us, you will contribute directly to sustainable developments at a local, national and global level through your innovative applications. You provide answers to contemporary societal challenges.

• 
Moreover, we highly value a good work-life balance at VITO! This is achieved by adopting a flexible attitude depending on your specific needs.

A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.Functieomschrijving 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 
• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 
• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 
• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

About Our Client - Katoen NatieWe're proud to partner with Katoen Natie, a global logistics leader with over 170 years of experience operating from the strategic Gent Port. This innovative, international company specializes in warehousing, transport, and supply chain solutions, combining traditional family values with cutting-edge technology and a no-nonsense corporate culture.

At Katoen Natie, colleagues who take initiative and show dedication can grow quickly within their expanding international network.

Jobomschrijving

Ready to kick-start your logistics career? On behalf of our client Katoen Natie, we're seeking motivated Order Pickers / Warehouse Employees for their dynamic operations in Gent Zeehaven. This is a temporary contract with excellent potential for permanent employment - your chance to prove yourself while learning from industry experts.

As an order picker, you'll be a crucial link in the international logistics chain, handling valuable materials and ensuring smooth operations for clients worldwide. This versatile role offers the perfect opportunity to develop your skills in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.

• 
• YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:Order Picking: Accurately collect goods from warehouse locations using picking lists and handheld scannersQuality Control: Inspect items for damage and ensure correct quantities before processingPacking & Preparation: Prepare orders for shipping, including proper packaging and labelingReceiving: Unload deliveries, check incoming goods, and update inventory systemsInventory Management: Organize stock locations and maintain warehouse cleanlinessSafety Compliance: Follow all safety protocols and maintain a secure working environmentTeam Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across different shiftsContinuous Improvement: Suggest ways to optimize processes and increase efficiency

• Essential Requirements:Basic logistics experience (warehouse, order picking, packing, production) OR strong willingness to learnEnthusiastic attitude combined with a hands-on mentality - ready to roll up your sleeves!Reliability and punctuality - your team depends on youEye for detail and quality - accuracy is crucial in our operationsPhysical fitness - comfortable standing, walking, and lifting throughout your shiftAvailability for 2-shift system (early and late shifts)Basic Dutch or English communication skillsWhat Makes You Stand Out:Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or scanning equipmentForklift or reach truck certification (or willingness to obtain)Previous experience in international logistics or port operationsMultilingual skills for our diverse, international workplacePositive team player attitude with problem-solving mindset

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!
 

A selection of your responsibilities:
 

 
• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
 
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
 
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
 
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
 
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.
 
• You register and handle returns, claims and complaints in a timely manner and propose ways to prevent recurring issues.
 
• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.
 
• You mainly support B2C customers, while also assisting professional customers such as retailers and wholesalers with orders, service requests and online tools. 

We are looking for the following profile:
 

 
• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
 
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
 
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
 
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
 
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
 
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
 
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
 
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
 
• You are available for a full-time position.

What will you do?
 
 
 
• Picking and preparing various orders using a handheld scanner or voice picking system. 
 
• Checking, labeling, and securely packaging items. 
 
• Registering goods correctly in the system. 
 
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient operation of the warehouse. 
 
• You will work in a cold environment. 

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• You have experience as an order picker in a logistics environment. 
 
• You can start quickly and are motivated to learn. 
 
• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts (early-late, or night). 
 
• You speak and understand English well. 
 
• You have your own means of transportation.

jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage.

Our client is a multinational.

Jobomschrijving

1. Waste data and performance improvement - approximately 60-80% of the time

• Take ownership of the waste topic and improve the reliability of existing data.
• Analyse and reconcile datasets, primarily using Excel, to identify inconsistencies,gaps and opportunities for improvement.
• Interview key stakeholders and data owners to understand data sources, processesand challenges.
• Recommend practical improvements to data collection, data quality and reporting.
• Identify initiatives that could reduce waste volumes and improve treatmentmethods.
• Prepare polished PowerPoint presentations, including clear charts and concise data analysis, for senior management and ExCo audiences. This consultant is not expected to provide technical expertise or lead a tool transformation. The focus is on strong analytical skills, the ability to interpret and challenge the data, and working with key stakeholders to develop action plans to reduce waste and improve treatment methods.
2. Other ESG projects - approximately 20-40% of the time

We are primarily looking for an experienced consultant with strong analytical skills and a quick learning curve; prior ESG experience is not essential.The ideal candidate:* Has a consulting background, ideally with a Big Four firm or equivalent, or haspreviously worked in a comparable consulting environment.* Has excellent analytical skills and is highly proficient in Excel.* Understands new topics quickly, adapts easily and becomes autonomous rapidly.* Delivers rigorous, reliable work right first time.* Can synthesise complex information and create compelling presentations for senioraudiences.* Is comfortable engaging with a range of stakeholders and coordinating projects.* Has a predominantly "Blue and Red" profile: analytical, structured, rigorous andresults-oriented.* Fluent in French and English; Dutch is an asset but not a requirement.

For a major Belgian organisation undergoing a large-scale digital transformation, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead strategic initiatives within the digital payments domain.

The mission focuses on the modernization of the payment ecosystem, including acquiring services, Payment Service Providers (Psp), payment compliance and the evolution of customer-facing digital Sales channels.
Responsibilities

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic payment-related projects.

• Analyse the current payment landscape, contracts and operating model.

• Gather and challenge business, technical, financial and regulatory requirements.

• Define the target strategy for acquiring and Psp services.

• Prepare business cases, decision documents and tender documentation.

• Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Security, Architecture, Procurement and Business stakeholders.

• Manage the impact analysis on existing Sales and payment systems.

• Drive the definition of future payment architectures and payment flows.

• Coordinate transition activities between current and future payment providers.

• Manage project planning, budget, risks, dependencies and governance.

• Oversee integration, testing, deployment and go-live activities.

• Lead steering committees and provide regular reporting to senior management.

• Drive PCI-DSS compliance initiatives and establish a sustainable certification approach.

Practical information

• Location: Brussels (hybrid)

• On-site presence: 2-3 days per week

• Start date: ASAP

• Contract: Freelance

• Duration: Initial mission of 3 months with strong extension potential

Interested in learning more? Send me your updated CV and I'll be happy to discuss this opportunity with you.

• Minimum 7 to 10 years of experience in complex project management environments.

• At least 3 years of experience in electronic payments, including Acquiring, Psp and payment ecosystems.

• Strong experience managing large-scale digital transformation projects.

• Proven experience coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders.

• Experience delivering projects in environments with strict regulatory and security requirements.

• Demonstrated experience with supplier and vendor management.

Key skills:

• Project Management

• Budget Management

• Risk & Dependency Management

• Stakeholder Management

• Business Analysis

• Payment Ecosystem (Acquiring, Psp, Card Payments)

• PCI-DSS Compliance

• Procurement & RFP Management

• Test & Transition Management

• Communication & Executive Reporting

Nice-to-have:

• Experience managing public tenders or large RFP processes.

• PMP and/or Prince2 Practitioner certification.

• Experience in highly regulated environments.

Languages:

• Native or bilingual level in French or Dutch

• Professional level in English

For an internationally active company specialized in automated warehouse systems and logistics automation, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Automation Technician / PLC Technician to join the permanent night shift team.
 

You will ensure that highly automated warehouse and logistics systems continue to operate efficiently and reliably.
 

As an Automation Technician, you will be responsible for the maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of automated installations.
 

Your responsibilities:
 

 
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on complex automated installations.
 
• Diagnosing and resolving technical faults and breakdowns.
 
• Troubleshooting issues in electrical, mechanical and automated systems.
 
• Working with PLC controls, sensors, motors and SCADA systems.
 
• Ensuring that automated warehouse installations operate safely and efficiently.
 
• Carrying out technical interventions independently and identifying the root cause of malfunctions.
 
• Recording maintenance activities and interventions correctly in the CMMS system (Sprocket).
 
• Working independently during the permanent night shift, while consulting colleagues when necessary.
 
• Contributing to the safety, reliability and efficiency of the installations. 

 
• A technical degree in electromechanics, electricity, automation and/or mechanics.
 
• Several years of experience as an Automation Technician, Maintenance Technician, Service Technician, Troubleshooting Technician or PLC Technician.
 
• Basic knowledge of industrial automation and PLC systems.
 
• Knowledge of sensors, motors, electrical components and technical installations.
 
• Experience with or an interest in SCADA and CMMS systems.
 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 
• A proactive, independent and accurate working attitude.
 
• A good command of Dutch and/or English.
 
• No fear of heights, as you may work at different levels within the automated installations.
 
• Good physical fitness.
 
• A strong interest in technology and a willingness to continue learning.
 
• The flexibility and motivation to work in 2 shifts

For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in the centre of Brussels close to the metro, bus and train stations in a new modern building.

Jobomschrijving

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).
